text_block_list.text:
I hear Голд Шип's voice coming from the
roof one
day and decide to investigate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Not to worry... You're safe now.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Once again, I've managed to protect the

academy from the threat beyond the
stars...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
It sure took a lot out of me, though...
Recovering
is gonna take a while...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I don't know about the threat beyond
the stars,
but Голд Шип's exhaustion
seems real. It takes
her a while to get
back in form.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
